remote_drafts.body:
Oversized canvas JSON was rejected only after building large outputs: the actual baseline apply allocated 2,097,152 bytes in one request before refusal. This counts borrowed geometry and its JSON-string-wrapped ABI envelope before reserving output, preserves exact legacy wire bytes, shares immutable admitted frame buffers, and compares canonical model bytes without owning another model-sized string. Known committed-model actions no longer serialize before/after every dispatch.

Prerequisite: exact RR18a #112 at b304b6df8711062cece3e2a557a3f73d3f9dc462. Two commits separate implementation and sealed evidence. No Cargo/registry changes, held raw/graph/factory features, merge or deployment. Land prerequisites, retarget and requalify.

Verification: 60 default Rust cases, scoped formatting, all-target Clippy and fresh release WASM pass. The reproduced refusal now passes with no allocation request above 65,536 bytes in its measured apply window, preserving prior canvas/history. Desktop/mobile actual controls verify layout/compute/apply, rotation, history, geometry import, model staging/commit and refusal; ordinary uninstrumented RR18a recovery/download/keyboard and identity checks pass. One browser locator failure is retained and corrected without replaying unchanged Rust suites. Independent source/evidence review covers 91 seals and 4,696 input bindings.

This is the foundation child of RR18b, split before mutation. Full HTML/helper allocation, draft-cache composition and required <50 ms whole-task acceptance remain RR18b3. Individual instrumented task observations are 106/65 ms versus baseline 111/69 ms, not a statistical improvement or accepted latency budget. External phase-fixture current hash/provenance and the historical missing per-epoch fixture guard are explicitly documented. Requests still allocate a bounded canonical key; wire caches can increase retained memory; explicit exports own a copy. No whole-app memory or full SysON parity claim.

See porting/rust-parity-evidence/RR18b1/RESULTS.md and SHA256.json.

remote_drafts.body:
Recovery could lose unrelated creation/import/geometry drafts. This adds bounded presentation-only retention with exact document/selection scope, focus/caret and disclosure restoration. Quota refusal keeps the connected DOM; acknowledged import/confirmed discard clears old contexts. Mandatory cancellation now suppresses stale canvas callbacks even when draft quota blocks dispatch.

Independent review also found a real UI deadlock: selecting a valid long imported element ID blocked later actions. A focused second source commit charges full exact inspector identity only when needed, preserves native disclosure defaults, and provides mutable document-level quota escapes. No model JSON copy/hash, semantic engine or asynchronous request queue is added.

Prerequisite: exact RR18a #112 at b304b6df8711062cece3e2a557a3f73d3f9dc462. Three commits preserve initial implementation, the independently found long-ID correction, and sealed evidence. Only loader.js is production code. No held raw/graph/factory features, merge or deployment. Land prerequisites, retarget and requalify.

Verification: final-source actual browser runs pass six long-ID cases (214/200014/600014 characters at 320/1440 widths), twelve cache guards, recovery/Keep/confirm, the callback race and both encoding/decoding faults. Ordinary uninstrumented recovery preserves model/canvas/history/drafts and downloads exact 900381-byte JSON / 2701179-byte URI; keyboard, identity, console and screenshots are checked. Nine scripts pass on the exact corrected B1+B2 candidate 40b3c1b3e6d86fb9ba082864dda4d17e6be8ee5b. Qualified unchanged Rust WASM is explicitly reused; no fresh Rust tests/build are claimed. Independent review covers 330 sealed files, 4706 isolated and 4786 separate joint bindings.

Original failures, prior-source passes, surrogate oracle correction, newline timeout and long-ID near-budget setup correction are retained with exact attribution. Final joint phase observations are 105/70 ms and canvas 108/67 ms: required <50 ms acceptance remains OPEN in RR18b3. Cache bounds do not bound full HTML/DOM work, heap/RSS or broad usability. Missing CJK glyph coverage and other UI polish remain explicit tasks. No complete SysON parity claim.

See porting/rust-parity-evidence/RR18b2/RESULTS.md, PERFORMANCE-SCENARIOS.json and SHA256.json.
